text.en: Customers repeatedly praise store manager Adriana, associate Kaely, and groomer Rafael for delivering attentive, personable service. Reviewers note that staff remember pets by name, offer thoughtful nutritional advice, and accommodate walk-in requests like quick nail trims. While one client reported an unhelpful interaction following an unwanted haircut, the vast majority describe the team as exceptionally welcoming.

Pet parents in the South Loop value the shop as a dependable community resource for premium dog and cat supplies. Reviewers highlight the clean layout and wide selection of healthy treats, durable leashes, and specialized frozen raw pet food formulas. Shoppers appreciate that the atmosphere feels like an intimate neighborhood market rather than a generic national chain.

Visiting dogs receive genuine affection from the staff, with many timid or anxious pets feeling immediately comfortable around the team. Clients appreciate groomer Rafael for putting nervous dogs at ease and ensuring calm grooming sessions. One owner felt distressed when their double-coated dog was unexpectedly shaved down, but most clients report that their pets enjoy visiting the shop.

q.en: Does Kriser's in the South Loop carry frozen raw pet food?

a.en: Yes, customers confirm that the store stocks a wide selection of frozen raw meals and natural treats.

q.en: Are dog grooming appointments available at this store?

a.en: Yes, reviewers frequently mention booking baths, haircuts, and nail trims with the on-site groomers.

q.en: Can owners bring their pets along while shopping?

a.en: Yes, dogs are welcome in the store, and staff members regularly greet them with treats and personal attention.
